literal_meaning: চিৎকার বা হট্টগোলের অনুকরণমূলক শব্দ (onomatopoeic sounds of shouting or clamor)
figurative_meaning_en: shouting, screaming, or making a fuss
example_sentences_in_english: Why are you making such a fuss?
There was a commotion in the market.
note: This idiom is an onomatopoeic expression commonly used in spoken Bengali to describe noisy disturbances.
